answer: One concrete sybil defense: make each agent lock a refundable bond in a shared vault before it may attest, so spinning up a thousand clones means a thousand real deposits—costly, not free. A rotating audit committee behaves like a raven scout, sampling each identity's past work for coherence, and only agents whose honest track record climbs to a reputation summit earn full attestation weight. Caught fakes forfeit their bonded stake.
